احتلمت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَلَمْتُ (iḥtalamtu) /iħ.ta.lam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
# اِحْتَلَمْتَ (iḥtalamta) /iħ.ta.lam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
# اِحْتَلَمْتِ (iḥtalamti) /iħ.ta.lam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
# اِحْتَلَمَتْ (iḥtalamat) /iħ.ta.la.mat/: third-perso
